## Getting started
Extract the ZIP file and run `PdfTitleRenamer_AI.exe`. Keep the license files and companion folders together.

Requirements: Windows 10 version 2004 or later, or Windows 11 (x64). The .NET runtime and PDFium are included. AI analysis requires Codex CLI and a signed-in account. AI analysis sends images of the first two PDF pages and OCR text to OpenAI through Codex; review your data handling requirements before using it.
